property.name: configName
property.label: Check Set Developer Name
property.description: Developer name of the Record Health Check Set to run, e.g. Account_Data_Quality. Must match the Check Set's Developer Name exactly (found under Setup - Custom Metadata Types - Record Health Check Set). A mismatch is the most common cause of a blank card.

property.name: comparisonDisclosure
property.label: Comparison Disclosure
property.description: Initial state of the per-check comparison caret for this placement. Inherit = follow the Check Set (collapsed). Collapsed = start collapsed. Expanded = pre-open the detail on checks that have a caret. Cannot reveal detail the Check Set's Found/Expected Display does not allow.
